body.name: Normalized monomial-row quotient
body.construction: The action is \((a,\pi)\cdot A=\operatorname{diag}(a_1,\ldots,a_q)P_\pi A\) for \(a_i\neq0\). Its normalized lift is \(\ell(A)\), its finite normalized orbit is \(\mathcal O_U(A)=\{\ell(MA):M\in\mathcal G_q\}\), and the quotient carries \(d_{\mathrm{orb}}(A,R)=\min_{M\in\mathcal G_q}\|\ell(A)-\ell(MR)\|_{\mathrm F}\). Compact normalized matrix sets carry the Frobenius Hausdorff metric \(d_{\mathrm H,F}\).
